start.content: He spoke of the end, Scribe. Not just of our lives, but of those great stones down there. He says not one will be left standing.

signs.content: He warned us of deceptions and wars. But he also said the Good News must reach all nations first. It's a heavy burden to carry.

doom.content: That is what we thought. But look at his face—he isn't guessing. He is mourning what he knows is coming.

end.content: Watch and pray. Those were his words.
